extracted.summary: Ongoing WhatsApp conversation between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about a property purchase for her family; Layla (with her husband Karim, who must approve the purchase) laid out a budget cap and a growing list of property requirements, a viewing was confirmed, and several commitments were exchanged on both sides. Extended WhatsApp conversation between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about an ongoing property search (initially Arabian Ranches, later broadened), with listings shared over several months; several requirements, concerns, family details and two commitments (one from Layla pending bank approval, one from Sam about a landlord check) emerged amid heavy small-talk filler. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about a property search for her and her husband Karim. The requirement evolved from a 3-bedroom to a 4-bedroom home after Karim's mother decided to move in, and they later added a studio investment property for her. Several concerns were raised (lack of shade at a Damac Hills property, affordability of a 5M listing), and the rep made several commitments including a mortgage broker introduction and, after a later viewing, follow-ups on pool depth, service charge history, and booking a second viewing. Mostly routine scheduling chatter between Sam Karimi and Layla Haddad with property listings shared; a meeting was confirmed for 12 November 2026 at 4pm, and Layla shared her husband Karim's birthday and their anniversary dates along with a tentative decision timeline from Karim.
